title: Bitcoin near $64,350 as weak liquidity and subdued on-chain activity signal caution - The Economic Times
text:
Bitcoin remained near the $64,000 mark as analysts flagged caution amid weak spot liquidity and subdued on-chain activity, despite signs of stabilising capital flows. Short covering and improving spot ETF flows provided some support, while experts highlighted key support and resistance levels as the cryptocurrency remained in a consolidation phase.
